data.completion_memo:
Fixed both contributing causes. (1) graph_pass/model_call.rs: the model_call node's assistant text is trimmed before it becomes the node value, so a provider that separates its answer from its reasoning with a blank line no longer hands "

SIMPLE" to the graph; this matches the agent path, which already trims (model_tool_loop.rs). (2) graph_pass.rs: evaluate_predicate routes eq/neq through the new predicate_values_equal helper, which compares two strings with surrounding whitespace ignored and keeps exact equality for every other type (text still never equals a number, a structured value or null); this protects existing saved workflows whose conditions were written against padded text, and it covers loop exit conditions and nested and/or/not predicates because they evaluate through the same function. Raw provider evidence is untouched: only the graph value is trimmed. Design check: the predicate semantics are not asserted anywhere in the design model or docs, so no design drift; the change implements the intent the Triage Router already documented. Tests: predicate_string_equality_ignores_surrounding_whitespace (padded value matches on both sides, a different value still fails, trimming never coerces types) and a_padded_model_call_answer_takes_the_true_route (a scripted provider answering "

SIMPLE" through a model_call node now carries "SIMPLE", the eq condition routes true, quick.1 completes and deep.1 is skipped rather than run). Verification: cargo test --lib -- graph_pass -> 23 passed, 0 failed, exit 0. Documentation: the eq/neq contract is stated in desktop/skills/aworkit-workflows/references/nodes.md. Formatting: the new lines are rustfmt-clean; the crate has no rustfmt.toml and many pre-existing diffs, so no repo-wide format was run. No blocker.
data.description: Defect: a Triage Router condition misroutes a SIMPLE classification down the tool-enabled branch. In chat chat.ba470e6a1d3ebc8c2aa7172503db9309cf5b5c75 (workflow.custom.6 v5) classify.1 returned "\n\nSIMPLE"; route.1's predicate {kind:eq,path:value,value:"SIMPLE"} is a strict JSON comparison, so the padding made it false and the run went route.1 --false--> gate.1 approval --> deep.1 "Grounded answer" (26 tools) --> web_search, while quick.1 "Direct answer" (toolIds []) was skipped as "branch not taken". Two contributing code facts: graph_pass/model_call.rs returns a non-plan model_call value untrimmed, while the agent path trims assistant_text in model_tool_loop.rs; and evaluate_predicate eq/neq does no normalisation. Fix: trim the model_call node's returned text (symmetry with agent nodes) and ignore surrounding whitespace when both sides of eq/neq are strings, with regression tests.
data.title: Fix whitespace-sensitive condition routing (Triage Router misroute)
